title: How Accurate Is Our Automatic 360°-Camera Reconstruction Pipeline?
subtitle: Benchmarking the OVR 360° Pipeline Against a Simultaneous LIDAR Survey of the Same Site
description: We rode a LIDAR scanner and our 360° camera on the same pole through a 40 × 25 m site and compared the two reconstructions point by point: median surface agreement of 3.9 cm — at the reference scanner's own declared accuracy — drift-free geometry over the 118 m path, and one uniform 2.9% scale disagreement that the measurement chain traces to the metric reference rather than the reconstruction, removable with a single scalar.
author: OVER Research
